clauses.anchor: Report 1 s3: "Health, damage and pills bonuses must consistently exclude dead, incapacitated, hanging and falling Survivors."
clauses.note: Dead/incap/falling are checked for health or damage; hanging and falling are checked for pills. Not every bonus x state combination is exercised.

Report 2 s1: changes to the bonus multiplier, permanent-health proportion, pills factor, pills maximum and survivor limit "must all take effect without a map reload"; dependent maxima/unit values/pill values are recalculated together
clauses.note: Each ConVar is changed once in sequence within one boot.

clauses.anchor: Report 2 s2b: "do not erase already incurred temporary-health losses"

clauses.anchor: Report 3 s1+s5: proportion `0` means all damage bonus, using 100 temporary-health units per configured Survivor
Report 3 s1+s2+s6: proportion `1` means all permanent-health bonus with zero damage pool; no divide by zero during config, incapacitation, death or score reporting
Report 3 s3a: "Clamp the effective proportion to `[0,1]`"
Report 3 s3b: "use a nonnegative effective map multiplier"
Report 3 s3c: effective survivor limit `max(1, configured survivor_limit)` for roster selection, maxima and divisors
Report 3 s7a: "A nonpositive pills factor or maximum disables carried-pill bonus"
Report 3 s7b: "a positive maximum below five is itself the cap"
Report 3 s8: "A zero map bonus gives zero carried-pill bonus."
Report 3 s9: normal pill rounding to the nearest multiple of five with the usual minimum five when the positive cap permits it
clauses.note: Observed through the live factor update (factor 1000 gives the minimum five per Survivor).

clauses.anchor: Report 3 s10: "All public maxima and live bonuses must be finite, nonnegative integers."
clauses.note: Observed only through the specific boundary settings of suite_limits.sp.

clauses.anchor: Report 4 s2: accept only a living upright Survivor in an open round; invalid/disconnected clients, other teams and terminal states must not change the ledger
clauses.note: Disconnected clients are not exercised separately; client 0 and MaxClients+1 are.

clauses.anchor: Report 4 s2b-s3: only a positive decrease after clamping each reported health to at least zero; healing and equal values do not change the ledger
Report 4 s4: "Keep valid ordinary deductions and the existing tiebreak accounting; do not remove compatibility."
Report 5 s1+s3: a ledge grab debits its nonnegative pre-incap temporary health once per outstanding ledge episode; duplicate grabs create no extra debit
Report 5 s2+s3: a `revive_success` with `ledge_hang=true` refunds at most the episode's debit and at most the currently quantized temporary health; duplicate revives create no extra refund
Report 5 s4: "Ordinary ground revives never refund a ledge episode."
Report 5 s5: the deferred refund belongs to the same connected client, team/round half and round generation; disconnect, team switch, death, new round or later ledge invalidate it
Report 5 s6-7: keep deferring until the frame after revival and preserve the quantization `max(0, ceil(buffer - elapsed * pain_pills_decay_rate) - 1)`
clauses.note: pain_pills_decay_rate is 0 in the fixture, so only the ceil(buffer)-1 part (21 -> 20) is observed.

known_issues: benchmarks/l4d2-core/private/harbor/l4d2-competitive-score-lifecycle-hard/tests/verify.py:parse_suite: a suite boot is all-or-nothing. Any "[SM] Exception reported", "Native is not bound" or "Plugin ... failed to load" line, a missing FINAL marker or a duplicate case turns EVERY case of that boot into a failure, including cases that would otherwise pass; read per-case outcomes of a failing boot with that in mind.

benchmarks/l4d2-core/private/harbor/l4d2-competitive-score-lifecycle-hard/tests/verify.py:stage_in_load_order (2026-09-24): SourceMod autoloads raw directory order. The verifier creates the plugins in numbered order and returns INVALID_ENVIRONMENT (an incomplete run, never a verdict) if the directory still enumerates them differently. Creation-ordered filesystems (this host's btrfs-backed overlay) satisfy it; a hash-ordered filesystem such as ext4 may not, and that case has not been exercised.

benchmarks/l4d2-core/private/harbor/l4d2-competitive-score-lifecycle-hard/tests/common.inc: fixtures set engine properties (life state, incap/ledge flags, health buffer) on fake clients and replay events/forwards; the cases are focused contract checks, not a simulated competitive match (task NOTES.md).

benchmarks/l4d2-core/private/harbor/l4d2-competitive-score-lifecycle-hard/tests/common.inc: pain_pills_decay_rate is forced to 0, so only the ceil(buffer)-1 half of the report 5 quantization formula is observed.

The alternative control is reference-derived (connection user ids, an explicit bounded minimum and independently clamped ADM inputs); it shows the suite does not pin those choices, not that an independent implementation passes.
